items.label: Nightstand with Charging Station
items.value: In order to meet more charging needs, this night stands adopts the latest plug-in design. Our end table with usb ports and outlets has 2 outlets and 1 usb port and 1 type-c port which can totally charge your lamps, phones, tablet at the same time, No need to go outside to find an outlet

items.label: Multiple Storage Options
items.value: 3 tier bed side table set of 2 with drawers provide incredible storage space for you. Top panel and 2 open compartment can hold common items and equipment such as decorations, cell phones, books, game consoles, record players, etc. Closed fabric drawer with handles can hold personal items and less frequently used items to help you organize your belongings in a small space. Suitable for living room, bedroom, dining room, office, game room

items.label: Lightweight and Long-Lasting
items.value: Our night stands for bedroom set of 2 are made of particle board and carbon metal. The small end table is easy to clean and maintain.The fabric drawer design of the nightstand not only provides you with perfect storage space, but also greatly reduces the weight of the nightstand so that you can move the 2 set of nightstands easily

items.label: Easy to Assemble
items.value: Simple structure, numbered parts, installation manual and tools allow you to finish the end tables in 30 minutes. If the product comes with missing parts or damaged parts, please feel free to contact us and we will arrange new parts replacement

items.label: Perfect Gift
items.value: This night stand set 2 is the ideal gift for your child to show your care and love in their bedroom or living room. The lightweight design is easy to move around, perfect for apartments, dorm, small rooms. The top and middle shelf of the side table are crafted from FSC-certified wood panels
